data.body: Local evidence (2026-11-09 PST, ubuntu:26.04 container on colima, bwrap 0.11.1, privileged root container). Before the fix at 872e7f6c3fd: the gate fails head/gates with EBUSY then EEXIST on .mutation-pytest, matching the CI artifact. With the committed fix (_bwrap_argv binds only outermost allow-list paths): the real gate, run per shard under bwrap, passes signing, next-batch, gates, validate, compact-policy and push-policy, with no UNSANDBOXED waiver line in any shard's stderr. reducer-processors fails its clean baseline on test_cache_invalidated_on_file_deletion (equal mtime), which fails 16/30 in the same container with no sandbox; tracked in fast-knotty-xiaosaurus. New live test test_the_child_can_delete_and_recreate_a_nested_basetemp fails under real bwrap before the fix (rmtree EBUSY) and passes after; full test_mutation_sandbox.py passes 47/47 under REBAR_REQUIRE_SANDBOX_ENFORCEMENT=1 in the container. Fail-open waiver filed separately as nonfat-wimpy-aurochs (a different cause: the workflow's unconditional REBAR_MUTATION_ALLOW_UNSANDBOXED).
